cutoff_sweep.note: the m=2 tail sweep follows the plan literally; at m=2 the ForwardProducts contrast is not yet visible (forward error 1.9e-3, 1.3e-3, 1.3e-3), so the method contrast is recorded at m=4 where it is. C = 16 and 20 extend the plan's C <= 12 range to windows that cover the seed many times over; they solve to 1e-10 relative residual with a 1024-step cap because the smallest scheduled shift stalls just above 1e-13 there

energy_convention: H = dGamma(h) with h = 1/2 p^2 + 1/2 k^2 phi^2 + lambda/4 (phi^2 - v^2)^2; the lambda v^4/4 constant is retained and lifts to c N_out; products are formed inside h before dGamma
limitations: the full-action defect envelope is now a grid-converged maximum sampled along the returned trajectory, which removes the shift-scaled ||D G||_F ||c|| exp(omega t) product: the state bound falls from 5.95 to 0.18 at the base cell. It is charged as 2 eps + eps^2 and is sound, but it stays ~25x the true state error and ~600x the true probability error, so it cannot certify a 1e-3 response; the sharp-tier charge (measured compressed-flow discrepancy against the exact Padé evolution of the declared window) is what does
the rank-2 cell on the degree-2 window reports the windowed return probability, which is 8.65e-4 below the converged window value because the omitted tail (squared norm 9/2) is projected out
the ForwardProducts diagnostic is more accurate than shift-invert at m = 4 on these bounded windows; the plan's degradation claim appears only as growth with C, not as a rank-for-rank deficit
momenta are continuous; no lattice or momentum sum is used anywhere in this record
